---
name: Arrow
url: https://rules.sudoku-sleuth.com/arrow.md
kind: arrow
parameters:
  partial:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether the declaration supplies only a shaft fragment, for example under fog.
    default: false (complete arrow).
  bulb:
    description: The bulb cells in decimal reading order, normally left to right or top to bottom.
    default: Required.
    type: list<cell>
  line:
    description: The shaft cells in order, for example r1c1-r1c2-r1c3.
    default: Required.
    type: path<cell>
---

Class: **existential**
```text
|bulb|>0 ∧ let B = Σ_{i∈[0,|bulb|)} D(bulb[i])*10^(|bulb|-1-i);
  (partial → ∃remainder:list<digit>: |remainder|>0 ∧ (∀d∈remainder: d∈𝔄) ∧ sum_D(line)+Σ_{d∈remainder} d=B)
  ∧ (¬partial → (|bulb|=1 → valueSum(line)=V(bulb[0]))
    ∧ (|bulb|!=1 → sum_D(line)=B))

```

---
name: Cage Shapes
url: https://rules.sudoku-sleuth.com/cage-shapes.md
kind: cage-shapes
parameters:
  size:
    description: The number of cells in each constructed region or cage.
    default: Required.
    type: position
  hidden:
    description: "Each hidden cage: its clue cell, total and known member cells."
    default: Required.
    type: list<record{clue:cell,sum:number,known:set<cell>}>
  free:
    description: Cells excluded from all hidden cages.
    default: Required.
    type: set<cell>
---

Class: **existential**
```text
∃chosen:list<set<cell>>:
  |chosen|=|hidden|
  ∧ (∀i∈[0,|hidden|): let h=hidden[i]; let cageSet=chosen[i];
    |cageSet|=size ∧ cageSet⊆C ∧ connected(cageSet) ∧ h.known⊆cageSet
    ∧ cageSet∩free=∅ ∧ h.clue∈cageSet ∧ (∀c∈cageSet: cellIndex(h.clue)<=cellIndex(c))
    ∧ distinct_D(cageSet) ∧ sum_D(cageSet)=h.sum)
  ∧ (∀i,j∈[0,|hidden|): i!=j → chosen[i]∩chosen[j]=∅)

```

